Workspace precedent for a passing gate is about 2.5-3 percent. Origin recovery hands the solver the hidden status-log ledger verbatim because both farms and their controller logs are public and ship inside the dataset. Public-source reversibility measured during scouting before any build. Exact-match attacker over the full public pool of 417,335 CRSS crashes: the planned rich public representation identifies the origin crash uniquely for 100% of cases; a mid representation 98.6%; a lean one 85.1%; and even the design floor (unit counts plus the unordered event-type multiset, with every piece of physical evidence removed) still gives 8.8% unique origin identification and 33.7% exact hidden-ledger recovery by retrieval alone. Workspace pass bar is ~2.5-3%. Source access, public-domain redistribution, native analyst-coded targets and scale (143,313 crashes with >=2 events) all passed; reversibility is intrinsic because the per-vehicle damaged-area set alone is a near-unique fingerprint and the evidence vector the task needs carries far more than log2(417335)-5 bits.
